column3: NASB renders “we make known” as “we wish to make known” and “bestowed among” as “given in.”
NASB follows the critical text; “proof” is rendered “ordeal,” and “generosity” is “liberality.”
NASB follows the critical text (“beyond”); it adds “they gave.”
NASB follows the critical text without the Textus Receptus “that we would receive”; it renders the phrase as “the favor of participation in the support of the saints.”
NASB adds “this,” renders “hoped” as “expected,” and omits “then.”
NASB renders “exhorting” as “urged” and “grace” as “gracious work.”
NASB follows the critical text (“the love we inspired in you”); it adds “see that” and renders “grace” as “gracious work.”
NASB renders “genuineness” as “sincerity.”
NASB adds “though” and “yet” and reorders the verse.
NASB renders “judgment” as “opinion” and “began before” as “were the first to begin,” and it reorders the verse.
NASB renders “out of that which you have” as “by your ability.”
NASB follows the critical text without “anyone”; it adds “it is … according to what a man has.”
NASB follows the critical text without “now”; it adds “this is” and “by way of.”
NASB renders “excess” as “abundance” and “need” as “want,” and it adds “being a supply.”
The quotation is in capitals, with the supplied word “gathered.”
NASB reads “puts,” the present of other manuscripts; the critical text has “gave.”
NASB adds “not only” and reorders the verse.
NASB renders “praise” as “fame” and adds “has spread.”
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “having been chosen” as “appointed” and adds “to show.”
NASB renders “avoiding” as “taking precaution,” “blame” as “discredit,” and “abundance” as “generous gift.”
NASB follows the critical text (“for we have regard”); “right” is rendered “honorable.”
NASB renders “proven … earnest” as “tested and found diligent” and restructures the verse.
NASB renders “apostles” as “messengers” and “glory of Christ” as “a glory to Christ.”
NASB follows the critical text; “in the face of” is rendered “openly before,” and it reorders the verse.
